name: (03) Obtenebration — 2 Intermediate — Arms of the Abyss

system.description:
From the shadowed corners of a room or the black of night, writhing tentacles rise at your command, lashing out to ensnare and strike while you stand free to act.

Spend one Blood Trait to summon the tentacles, plus one Social Trait for each tentacle created. Each is six feet long with three Physical Traits and four Health Levels; every additional Blood Trait spent grants one tentacle an extra Physical Trait or six more feet of reach. You direct them — grabbing, whipping, holding items — even while taking your own actions. They take damage normally and suffer fire and sunlight as a vampire does, but share any Fortitude you possess, and you may lend them your Potence (though not at the same time as Fortitude). They last the scene unless dispelled or you fall unconscious or into torpor. Their effects cannot be combined with any other Discipline.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
